## Control details

### FI-01 · Asset inventory and ownership

Every cloud resource carries Project, Environment, VantaOwner and DataClassification tags; resources holding personal data are flagged.

- **Implemented in:** `infra/aws/main.tf`, `infra/azure/main.tf`
- **Evidence:** evidence-plan-* artifact (policy-*.json); Azure Policy compliance export
- **Vanta:** Resource inventory owners and user-data flags from Vanta* tags

### FI-02 · Encryption at rest

S3 SSE, DynamoDB SSE, Azure Storage infrastructure encryption, Cosmos DB service-managed encryption.

- **Implemented in:** `infra/aws/web.tf`, `infra/aws/data.tf`, `infra/azure/main.tf`
- **Evidence:** Checkov SARIF in code scanning; AWS Config rule history
- **Vanta:** Storage and database encryption tests (AWS + Azure)

### FI-03 · Encryption in transit

HTTPS-only CloudFront and Functions, TLS 1.2 minimum on storage and Cosmos, HSTS, deny non-TLS S3 requests.

- **Implemented in:** `infra/aws/web.tf`, `infra/azure/main.tf`
- **Evidence:** policy-*.json; smoke test results
- **Vanta:** TLS and HTTPS enforcement tests

### FI-04 · No public data stores

S3 public access blocks on every bucket, private origin via CloudFront OAC, no public blob containers, no public Lambda URLs.

- **Implemented in:** `infra/aws/web.tf`, `infra/azure/main.tf`
- **Evidence:** policy-*.json; AWS Config rule history
- **Vanta:** Public bucket / container tests

### FI-05 · Keyless identity for pipelines and workloads

GitHub OIDC federation to AWS and Entra ID; Cosmos DB key auth disabled; Function uses managed identity; no cloud secrets stored in GitHub.

- **Implemented in:** `infra/bootstrap/aws/github_oidc.tf`, `infra/bootstrap/azure/github_oidc.tf`, `infra/azure/main.tf`
- **Evidence:** IAM trust policies; Entra federated credentials; gitleaks job logs
- **Vanta:** Access keys / service principal secret age tests (should find none)

### FI-06 · Least privilege

Separate plan (read-only) and deploy roles; deploy can manage only frostyirie-* roles and cannot touch CI or Vanta roles; RBAC admin constrained by ABAC condition; Lambda can only PutItem.

- **Implemented in:** `infra/bootstrap/aws/github_oidc.tf`, `infra/bootstrap/azure/github_oidc.tf`, `infra/aws/api.tf`
- **Evidence:** IAM Access Analyzer findings; role policies
- **Vanta:** IAM users/roles with admin access, quarterly access review task

### FI-07 · Change management and segregation of duties

Protected main branch, CODEOWNERS review, PR checklist, CI must pass, prod deploy requires a GitHub Environment approval by someone other than the author.

- **Implemented in:** `.github/CODEOWNERS`, `.github/pull_request_template.md`, `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`
- **Evidence:** PR history with approvals; deployment approval log in GitHub Environments
- **Vanta:** GitHub integration: branch protection, PR review before merge

### FI-08 · Policy-as-code deployment gate

Every plan is evaluated by Conftest (OPA) before apply; the exact plan that passed is the one applied.

- **Implemented in:** `policies/opa`, `scripts/plan_and_check.sh`, `scripts/deploy_infra.sh`
- **Evidence:** evidence-plan-*; evidence-deploy-policy artifacts
- **Vanta:** Upload evidence-deploy-policy as document evidence for the linked custom test

### FI-09 · Configuration drift detection

Nightly terraform plan per cloud; drift opens a labelled GitHub issue for triage.

- **Implemented in:** `.github/workflows/drift.yml`
- **Evidence:** drift issues and their resolution PRs
- **Vanta:** GitHub issues labelled drift can be linked as evidence

### FI-10 · Vulnerability and secret management

Dependabot for Actions, pip and Terraform providers; gitleaks on every push; Checkov SARIF in code scanning.

- **Implemented in:** `.github/dependabot.yml`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `.checkov.yaml`
- **Evidence:** code scanning alerts; Dependabot PRs
- **Vanta:** GitHub Dependabot / code scanning vulnerability SLAs

### FI-11 · Audit logging

Multi-region CloudTrail with log file validation (1 year), API Gateway access logs, Lambda logs without personal data, Azure diagnostics to Log Analytics.

- **Implemented in:** `infra/bootstrap/aws/state_and_audit.tf`, `infra/aws/api.tf`, `infra/azure/ops.tf`
- **Evidence:** CloudTrail digest files; Log Analytics workspace
- **Vanta:** CloudTrail enabled, log retention tests

### FI-12 · Monitoring and alerting

CloudWatch alarms on Lambda errors and API 5xx; Azure metric alert on Function 5xx; budget alerts in both clouds.

- **Implemented in:** `infra/aws/ops.tf`, `infra/azure/ops.tf`
- **Evidence:** alarm history; action group notifications
- **Vanta:** Monitoring / alerting configured tests

### FI-13 · Backups

DynamoDB PITR (35 days) + AWS Backup daily (35 days); Cosmos DB continuous backup (7 days); S3 and Azure blob versioning and soft delete.

- **Implemented in:** `infra/aws/data.tf`, `infra/aws/ops.tf`, `infra/azure/main.tf`
- **Evidence:** AWS Backup job history; Cosmos restorable timestamps
- **Vanta:** Database backups enabled tests

### FI-14 · Cross-cloud disaster recovery

Azure warm standby with its own copy of site and API; browser fails over API calls; CloudFront fails over site origin; orders replicated every 6 h (RPO 6 h, RTO 1 h target).

- **Implemented in:** `app/web/app.js`, `infra/aws/web.tf`, `scripts/dr_sync.py`, `.github/workflows/dr.yml`
- **Evidence:** evidence-dr-aws-to-azure-* artifacts; docs/runbooks/disaster-recovery.md
- **Vanta:** Upload quarterly DR test record; BCP/DR policy acceptance

### FI-15 · Restore testing

Monthly automated point-in-time restore of the orders table with measured RTO; quarterly manual Cosmos restore per runbook.

- **Implemented in:** `scripts/restore_drill_aws.py`, `docs/runbooks/disaster-recovery.md`
- **Evidence:** evidence-dr-restore-drill-* artifacts (400-day retention)
- **Vanta:** Backup restoration test evidence

### FI-16 · Data minimisation and retention

Personal data is stored separately from the order ledger and deleted after 30 days (DynamoDB TTL, Cosmos TTL); the ledger keeps only a one-way customer key; logs never contain personal data.

- **Implemented in:** `app/api/common/pricing.py`, `infra/aws/data.tf`, `infra/azure/main.tf`
- **Evidence:** unit-tests.xml; policy-*.json
- **Vanta:** Data retention policy acceptance; user-data tagged stores

### FI-17 · Transparency and lawful basis

Privacy notice linked at checkout; orders are refused without explicit acknowledgement; consent timestamp stored with the contact record.

- **Implemented in:** `app/web/privacy.html`, `app/web/index.html`, `app/api/common/pricing.py`
- **Evidence:** unit-tests.xml; privacy notice version history
- **Vanta:** Privacy policy document

### FI-18 · Order processing integrity

Prices, happy-hour discounts, service charge, 13% IVA and delivery fee are computed server-side from the versioned menu; client prices are ignored; orders are written atomically with unique IDs.

- **Implemented in:** `app/api/common/pricing.py`, `app/api/aws/handler.py`, `app/menu/menu.json`
- **Evidence:** unit-tests.xml; menu.json change history
- **Vanta:** Link unit test evidence to a processing-integrity custom test

### FI-19 · Secure web application

Strict CSP (no inline script), HSTS, frame-ancestors none, input validation and length limits, honeypot, API throttling, CORS pinned to the two site origins.

- **Implemented in:** `infra/aws/web.tf`, `infra/aws/api.tf`, `app/web/index.html`, `app/api/common/pricing.py`
- **Evidence:** policy-*.json; response headers from smoke tests
- **Vanta:** Application security review evidence

### FI-20 · Cloud cost guardrails

Budgets with forecast and actual alerts in both clouds; consumption-only App Service plans; always-free DynamoDB capacity.

- **Implemented in:** `infra/aws/ops.tf`, `infra/azure/ops.tf`, `policies/azure/fi-consumption-plans-only.json`
- **Evidence:** budget alert history
- **Vanta:** Vendor / cloud service management
